 Open Schedule Ticker Open Main Menu Football November 10, 2026 Share Twitter Facebook Email Five Things to Know: Virginia Tech vs. Stanford
 The gameday events, promotions and activities Hokie fans should know about this weekend
 Opens in a new window Stay Connected Opens in a new window SeatGeek Tickets vs. Stanford Opens in a new window Hokie Hour Opens in a new window Download Mobile Tickets BLACKSBURG – After what will almost be a month since their last competition at home, Virginia Tech football will return to Lane Stadium as they face the Stanford Cardinal on Saturday, Nov. 14 at 7:30 p.m. ET. The matchup will serve as the third time in contest history that the two teams have faced off against one another, and the first time in history that the contest will take place in Blacksburg.    
 This weekend’s home game against the Cardinal ushers in yet another variety of exciting promotions and thrilling gameday events that fans of all ages won’t want to miss. Read below to gather your Five Things to Know before the Hokies take to Worsham Field this Saturday night.    
 Hokie Hour –  As part of its ongoing commitment to elevate the Virginia Tech Gameday Experience, Virginia Tech Athletics is proud to announce Hokie Hour, an enhancement to stadium entry operations aimed at reducing congestion and improving the overall fan experience at Lane Stadium.   
 Gates will now open 2.5 hours prior to kickoff for the remainder of the football season. During Hokie Hour, which runs during the first hour of gates opening, fans can enjoy 50% off concessions (non-alcoholic) at most locations and an early bird special that includes $4 select domestic beers, $5 select import beers and $5 canned transfusions. Fans are encouraged to drink responsibly and must be 21 years or older.   
 The Hokie Shop (in-venue only) is joining in the fun during the Hokie Hour with the following special offers:   
 10% Off (NIL Merch + LPDF/Hokie Way/Hokie Effect Items Excluded)   
 Receive One Raffle Ticket for Every $50 Spent to be Entered to Win James Franklin + Bud Foster dual-signed VT Football   
 Custom Jersey Pre-Order Forms Will Be Available In-Store. Pre-Order and Enter to Win James Franklin + Bud Foster dual-signed VT Mini-Helmet   
 Gameday Experience and Mobile Tickets – Hokie Hour is just one of several additions and enhancements to the Virginia Tech Football Gameday Experience occurring in the 2026 season. Connectivity enhancements, LED light additions and a larger variety of concessions items are all available for fans to enjoy, giving gamedays at Lane that much more energy and thrill. Visit the Virginia Tech Gameday Experience landing page for a comprehensive look at the enhancements waiting for fans at Lane this season. Arriving early ensures you don’t miss a moment of the gameday excitement at Lane.   
 Additionally, be sure to download your tickets through the HokieSports App for an efficient and convenient mobile ticketing experience . After downloading your ticket to your mobile device, visit the phone wallet of your device and confirm your tickets are present.    
 Veterans/Ag Day – Virginia Tech Athletics is excited to honor military veterans at Lane Stadium with special experiences and opportunities this upcoming weekend. Additionally, Lane Stadium will celebrate Ag Day on Saturday. Sponsored by Virginia Farm Bureau, special events include a petting zoo at Hokie Village, Ag Day facts during the game. Purchase your own piece of merchandise from the Virginia Tech Athletics Military collection today!   
 Hokie Village – Hokie Village will open its doors to fans of all ages once again this gameday, welcoming fans from 4 p.m. to 6:45 p.m. The family-friendly hub will include games and activities, an Ag Day petting zoo, live music from the Billy T. Wilde Band, and a selection of local food trucks. Be sure to visit Hokie Village before entering Lane Stadium on Saturday!   
 Gameday Timeline – Gamedays in Blacksburg are full of events and excitement. Review the gameday timeline to make the most of your gameday.
